pages.text: An electron of Lorentz factor γ, bent by a field B, circles at r = γmc/eB with proper acceleration a = γ²c²/r. An accelerated observer sees the vacuum as a thermal bath at the Unruh temperature T = ħa/(2πck_B): about 214 K per thousand of γ per tesla, here. Synchrotron radiation drains the beam as γ³B; the cavities can replace up to 500 kW.
$(thing)Set$(): Lorentz factor, Bending field.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Beam energy jitter: γ varies by ±1%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The cavities cannot replace what the beam radiates; The bending magnets are saturating.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A more energetic beam works faster.
